strengths: MVP8 composes the already accepted MVP3-MVP7 gameplay, Matter, Item Graph and Construction owners into one connected two-client workload instead of introducing another canonical store.
The same lineage executes twelve bounded rounds, a fresh client reconnect, a quiescent server/world restart in new OS processes, current-state Matter resync and continued post-restart control.
Repeated dig/item/Construction operations are genuine canonical mutations: four spatially distinct Matter digs, four Item operations and two ADD/REMOVE Construction cycles.
Construction rebuild after the first damage/remove uses the accepted C9 DAMAGE_REPAIR path and preserves the same salvaged leaf/item identity rather than replaying a one-shot build-plan stage.

Timing repairs preserve fail-closed semantics: held input is explicitly neutralized, post-handoff input waits for an objectively newer server tick, backend liveness is idle-only, and no timeout/cap increase or hidden input retry was used.
Two exact runs of the same frozen HEAD/TREE pass all 20 acceptance checks and reject all 14 false-positive mutations.

findings.summary: Fresh independent Reviewer and Verifier must bind to frozen 90bc1026/4b6f2d48; two implementer exact passes are machine evidence, not independent verdicts.
Leaf closure still needs exact-head full world/core and standard/directional PC0 non-red evidence or an explicit policy-backed classification.

Attempt 2 phase1 authority/a backend sequence is 498 against cap 512 (14 calls headroom). The gate passes without eviction/retry/cap increase, but Fresh Reviewer should inspect whether the bound remains structurally robust to legitimate scheduling variation.
Server/world restart is from an acknowledged quiescent checkpoint; arbitrary loss of uncheckpointed operations is not claimed.

The workload label BUILD_ADD means restoring the removed construction leaf. After the initial historical build, subsequent ADD is canonically implemented by C9 DAMAGE_REPAIR using the same salvaged identity, not by reopening an already completed build-plan stage.
Recovery is intentionally staged across authenticated SETUP/GAMEPLAY/CONSTRUCTION RPCs so ENet servicing resumes between existing recovery participants; this creates no new canonical state owner.
